kind: prospective fresh-task current owned request and actual native comparison composition

panel.branch_rule: Each exact completed intake is an independent fixed branch; no selection of successful masks, no new task creation or accepted intake rerun.

runtime.scope: Derive the fresh owned need from the fully settled exact intake; merge one new pending entry with a copy of original effective demands, preserving every original controller/source/history byte separately. Require the new need to be the oldest current unfulfilled paid owned need. No older demand is skipped.
runtime.request: Use unchanged owned-native-request-v1 to form exact SelectionRequest or WorkflowSelectionRequest from current paid task/bind receipt; existing optional roles remain None. No capacity request, role expansion, new skill, route or winner is supplied.
runtime.comparison: Use unchanged PaidCanonicalComparisonEngine/PaidWorkflowComparisonEngine and PaidComparisonRequest semantics under fresh ft-owned-comparison:fresh:<intake digest> keys. Derive exact native snapshot, full33/32 cells, native nominee and existing extent. Pay native work before result receipt; snapshot remains predebit. Old labels denote unchanged algorithms, not new history selection.
runtime.lifecycle: Before,partial1,ready-unsettled: no result. Complete settlement: one receipt/result. Exact partial restart and terminal idempotence. One-unit cancellation retains debit/no refund/result. No movement, preparation debt discharge, reserve/history writes or authorization.
runtime.guards: Incomplete/forged intake, wrong original pairing, wrong fresh task, fabricated request/domain, receipt or extent must reject. Native suffix limited to exact comparison commands, access unchanged. Immutable accepted source caches may be bounded and keyed by exact checkpoint bytes.

audit: Separate auditor imports neither new runtime nor comparison executor. Reconstruct exact fresh owned payload and demand from native bindings and original controller, independent request fields, owned snapshot via accepted reference audit helper, full native per-cell reference comparison, native debit and protected result/receipt. Verify full original/intake audits, command/access/journal prefixes and exact suffix. Decode every saved native record and audit independently; retain native rejections and bounded search flags.
claim_boundary: Paid fresh-task bounded original-role comparison only. Not fresh skill work, complete role/operand coverage, current TD5/capacity admission, genuine distinct-element tie, history-caused choice, movement/downstream use or parent FT7/FT8/FT9 acceptance. Changed future inputs require new paid comparison and separately bound composition; no wallet refill, old wrapper regeneration or weakened FT8 denominator/matched-main-cost gate.
failure_policy: Preserve each failure and exact source; prospective corrections before code, new freeze before unchanged bounded retry. Never rerun accepted paid gates.
